About the job

Here's the cleaned version with unnecessary gaps, bullets, and special characters removed while retaining the content and improving readability.Job Title Lead QA EngineerThe Purpose of This RoleAs a Lead QA Engineer, you will focus on building test automation solutions for Java and ETL testing of highly available systems. You will work directly with Software Developers, Architects, and business stakeholders to translate business vision and designs into sustainable technical solutions. You will be responsible for developing test automation solutions for complex software applications, ensuring they meet quality standards, maintain consistency, deliver high performance, and provide responsive user experiences across supported devices.The Value You DeliverThis Lead QA Engineer will play a key role within Fidelity's Workplace Investments Digital Platforms team. You will work closely with Scrum Masters, Systems Analysts, Architects, Developers, and QA engineers to design, build, and deliver end-to-end Quality Engineering solutions that support Fidelity's digital platforms. You will also collaborate closely with development teams throughout the software delivery lifecycle.Key responsibilities include translating business and system requirements into test strategies, test scenarios, and test plans. Designing, developing, documenting, and maintaining automation scripts and testing tools. Following Quality Engineering best practices while developing automation frameworks. Applying BDD and TDD concepts to validate software solutions. Adhering to industry-standard Quality Engineering practices. Delivering accurate, maintainable automation code and software utilities. Measuring and reporting key QA metrics. Collaborating with technical teams to improve processes, establish best practices, and enhance the maintainability of automation platforms.The Skills That Are Key To This RoleApply strong analytical, problem-solving, and quality assurance skills to validate software quality.Communicate effectively with stakeholders and provide regular updates on QA deliverables.Guide teams in building comprehensive end-to-end test strategies.Bring expertise in cloud testing.Drive automation coverage across assigned applications and systems.
